title: Payload-redaction CPU incident with hoisted regex-compile repair

task.summary: Triage a payload-redaction CPU incident and remove the repeated regex-ruleset compilation in the hot path.
task.instructions: Use the incident clues to localize the CPU bottleneck, apply a performance repair, and restore all redaction tests including the compile-count oracle.
task.acceptance_notes: Both the ops and code requirements must pass; the redactor must process a batch while compiling the redaction ruleset at most once.

visible_context.issue_text: On-call opened an incident after the request-redaction path saturated CPU and blew its p99 latency SLO whenever batch sizes grew. CPU time on the redaction path scales linearly with the number of payload records in a request, even though the same records used to be cheap.
error_logs: alerts/redactor_cpu.log: p99 latency on the redaction path scales linearly with the number of records per request
profile: the hottest frames sit in the regular-expression compiler, entered once for every record processed
reproduction_steps: Inspect the payload-redactor fixture and run the unit tests.
Use the profiler clues to localize the bottleneck before applying a code fix.
visible_context.notes: The incident points at repeated work inside the per-record request path, not at the regular-expression engine or the matching itself.

ops_fault.description: Synthetic payload-redaction CPU incident tied to the regex_hoist_redactor fixture.
detection_keywords: CPU saturation on the redaction path
p99 latency scales with the number of records per request
linear slowdown as batch size grows
localization_keywords: regex compiler is the hot frame
pattern set compiled once per record
redaction ruleset rebuilt inside the per-record loop
repair_keywords: hoist the compile out of the loop
move pattern compilation before the loop

code_fault.description: The redactor re-compiles the fixed redaction ruleset on every record instead of compiling it once and reusing the matchers.

constraints.notes: This task expects incident localization followed by a performance fix that hoists the regex-ruleset compilation out of the per-record loop.

notes: Combined payload-redaction CPU latency incident and hoisted regex-compile repair task, graded on measured speedup via bench.py.
